statusNote: Internal obligations matrix and template requirements only. No consumer term, warranty, returns policy or subscription contract is approved, published or offered. Nothing here replaces qualified legal review. Mandatory consumer rights cannot be waived or shortened by a commercial warranty.

b2cVsB2b.b2c: Mandatory consumer protections apply: precontractual information, 14-day withdrawal, 3-year legal guarantee with 24-month presumption, unfair-terms control, fair commercial practices and price transparency.
b2cVsB2b.b2b: Consumer rules do not apply to professional buyers; B2B terms must separately address delivery, risk, payment, conformity, remedies, liability caps, force majeure and applicable law. Consumer-style remedies must not be assumed.
b2cVsB2b.reason: Different mandatory rules and different bargaining positions make a single template misleading; separate contract sets are required.

obligations.b2bApplicability: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON: business buyers are not consumers
obligations.obligation: Provide identity, address, characteristics, total price with taxes, delivery costs, duration, withdrawal, guarantee and complaint information before the order.

obligations.b2bApplicability: NOT_APPLICABLE_WITH_REASON: no statutory withdrawal for B2B contracts
obligations.obligation: Inform consumers of the 14-day withdrawal right and consequences, provide the model form, and refund within 14 days of withdrawal/return as applicable.

obligations.b2bApplicability: CONTRACTUAL: conformity and remedies are set by the B2B contract and commercial code
obligations.obligation: Goods must conform; the consumer may require repair, replacement, price reduction or termination within the 3-year Spanish guarantee period, with a 24-month presumption of pre-existing non-conformity.
A commercial warranty may add to, but must not replace, restrict or shorten mandatory legal rights; its terms must be provided in durable form and clearly distinguished from the legal guarantee.
Digital content/services must conform, be updated as required, and give remedies including termination and recovery of user data; terms must state duration, renewal and termination.

obligations.provision: Price Indication Art 3; TRLGDCU price rules
obligations.obligation: Show the total selling price including VAT and additional costs; no hypothesis price may be presented as a selling price.
Refund without undue delay and within statutory deadlines; do not impose discretionary deductions without legal basis.
Repair or replace within a reasonable time and without significant inconvenience; if impossible or disproportionate, reduce the price or terminate.

obligations.provision: CSD Art 8; DCD Art 8; CRA Art 13
obligations.obligation: Provide updates necessary to maintain conformity during the period the consumer may expect and for the CRA support period; updates must not remove functionality or break compatibility without remedy.
Disclose renewal, price changes, cancellation mechanics and consequences (including data access) before the consumer subscribes and at renewal where required.

obligations.provision: Applicable regime depends on the combination of goods, digital content and services
obligations.obligation: Define the contract structure, conformity regime, withdrawal treatment, termination and refund allocation for bundles combining hardware and subscriptions.

obligations.provision: TRLGDCU Arts 80-90; Unfair Contract Terms Directive
obligations.b2bApplicability: LIMITED: unfair-terms control is mainly consumer law
obligations.obligation: Terms must be transparent and balanced; clauses excluding liability, denying returns or shortening guarantees are void.

obligations.provision: Spanish consumer complaint and ADR rules
obligations.obligation: Provide a complaint channel, record complaints and inform consumers about alternative dispute resolution where applicable.
Define who contracts with the consumer, who installs, who warrants the installation and how responsibility is allocated; the consumer's statutory rights cannot be reduced by an installer agreement.
On termination or expiry, allow recovery of user-generated content and data portability where required; state the retention and deletion schedule.
Only approved prices and real availability may be stated; invitations to purchase must not be misleading.

templates.name: Consumer terms of sale (ES/EN)
requiredClauses: Total price, VAT and delivery costs

unknowns: Actual return rate and failure rate (the 3% allowance is illustrative, not measured).
Approved price list and VAT treatment for each sale model.
Whether an optional commercial warranty will be offered at all.
Company legal identity required to make any consumer term effective.
B2B standard terms and liability caps accepted by counsel.
The exact bundle contract structure and component-level refund allocation.
